notes: Chain recovery rule (ADR-0002): the 24-word BIP-39 entropy IS the 32-byte Ed25519 seed. No PBKDF2 passphrase and no HD path, so one phrase is exactly one wallet. The previous SLIP-0010 `m/44'/3007'/0'/0'/i'` vectors are obsolete: Android and the CLI never derived that way. Do not hand-edit; a mismatch is a finding.
